headline: U.S. missile stockpiles dwindle. And, FDA weighs approval of flu shots with mRNA tech
context: The U.S. Army's missile stockpile is dwindling and could take years to replenish. And, the Food and Drug Administration is deciding whether to approve a flu vaccine with mRNA technology.
